headline: Teach, challenge, and support.
description: Coaches will put player safety first, teach multiple positions and football concepts, run purposeful practices, communicate clearly, correct mistakes constructively, and give every rostered player a meaningful role.

headline: Bring your best controllables.
description: Be a great teammate. Be kind, respectful, and supportive. Bring confidence and personality while controlling your Focus, Attitude, Mindset, and Effort.

headline: Make the experience better.
description: Support every RFGF player, respect opponents and officials, let coaches coach, communicate concerns privately and constructively, meet team deadlines, and keep the car ride home centered on the player’s experience.
